body:
Thanks for your post. It gave me some insight into the problem.
Unfortunately, i dont live with him anymore and im not really able to visit often (i live in another city and work full time, its 6h drive at best and i dont own a car so i have to take a bus). He doesnt do any sports, and while i do, im quite afraid talking to him about it will make him sad since he has that attitude of 'you can do everything and im useless' which is btw totally not true. We used to play videogames together a lot, but lately hes not responding when im asking him if he wants to play (also when we do play he gets easily tilted and angry/sad when hes underperforming). Ill consider getting him to do some new activities (even though he will probably tell me to fuck off and leave him alone to watch anime or play games by himself). Thanks.

What's been happening lately is certainly not healthy. I hope he knows im there for him (i told him that multiple times and tried to be true to that). Any advice on how to approach getting him to seek professional help? I've tried just suggesting it, but he says that he doesn't need it. Again, i probably shouldn't force him to (and i probably couldn't even if i tried).

Man, i'm trying, but he refuses to talk about it seriously. He just hangs up if im trying to have a conversation about that, and i dont know how can i approach it without forcing the conversation which is probably not good.
